candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return msg.sender instead of the stored _owner, so calls to owner() return caller address rather than contract owner.
Removed the check preventing transfer to the zero address by deleting the require, allowing transferOwnership(address(0)).
Relaxed the onlyOwner guard by changing the check to compare against tx.origin instead of _msgSender(), altering who is authorized to call transferOwnership.
Made transferOwnership callable without the onlyOwner restriction by removing the modifier invocation, allowing anyone to change owner.
Change setRewardDistributor to require caller is current rewardDistributor instead of onlyOwner, so different caller can set and value may differ.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function setRewardDistributor(address _distributor) external { require(msg.sender == rewardDistributor, "not distributor"); rewardDistributor = _distributor; emit UpdatedRewardDistributor(_distributor); }

candidates.change_summary: Remove onlyOwner guard so anyone can call setRewardDistributor, allowing rewardDistributor to be changed to a different value by any caller.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function setRewardDistributor(address _distributor) external { rewardDistributor = _distributor; emit UpdatedRewardDistributor(_distributor); }

candidates.change_summary: Relax onlyOwner check to allow either owner or current rewardDistributor to act as owner, enabling rewardDistributor setter to be callable by additional principal and thus change value.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: modifier onlyOwner() { _checkOwner(); require(owner() == _msgSender() || _msgSender() == rewardDistributor, "Ownable: caller is not the owner"); _; }

candidates.change_summary: Make setRewardDistributor only callable by the contract owner and also set rewardDistributor to address(0) afterwards, resulting in a different stored value than original when called with a non-zero address.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function setRewardDistributor(address _distributor) external onlyOwner { rewardDistributor = _distributor; rewardDistributor = address(0); emit UpdatedRewardDistributor(_distributor); }

candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to migrator with assignment that only sets migrator when new address is non-zero (ignores zero address), changing observable migrator after setMigrator(0).
Replace assignment to migrator with inverted assignment (set to previous owner instead of provided address), altering migrator value after any call.
Replace assignment to migrator with assignment of msg.sender (caller) instead of provided address, causing migrator to equal caller after setMigrator.
Change onlyOwner to check against tx.origin instead of msg.sender, allowing different callers to pass and altering who can call setMigrator thus affecting migrator after setMigrator.
